rows.commentary: 6.6: Ishan Sood loops it full outside off, driven past backward point where a fumble allows Subhan Zakhail to pinch a single and get off the mark.
7.1: Kavya Patel drops it short and wide outside off, and Subhan Zakhail cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
7.2: Kavya Patel goes short and wide of off once more, prompting Subhan Zakhail to punch it directly to point.
7.3: Kavya Patel offers width outside off, drawing a fierce slash from Subhan Zakhail that narrowly misses the outside edge.
7.4: Kavya Patel serves up a fuller length outside off, safely driven straight down to mid-off by Subhan Zakhail.
7.5: Kavya Patel finds no movement through the air, allowing Subhan Zakhail to comfortably defend it into the off-side.
7.6: Kavya Patel targets the fifth stump line on a length, pushed towards point by Subhan Zakhail off the front foot with an open bat face.
8.1: Ishan Sood delivers a good length ball outside off, firmly defended off the front foot towards the covers by Faridullah Ihsas.
8.2: Ishan Sood digs it a touch shorter into the right-hander, allowing Faridullah Ihsas to turn it neatly toward square leg for a sharp single.
8.3: Ishan Sood sneaks one past the bat with low bounce, cleanly beating Subhan Zakhail on the outside edge.
8.4: Ishan Sood fires a length delivery well outside off, leaving a late-swinging Subhan Zakhail to slash hard and miss completely.
8.5: Ishan Sood pitches it in the probing channel outside off, squaring up Subhan Zakhail with a peach of a delivery that completes a hat-trick of missed strokes.
8.6: Ishan Sood drops it short and wide, allowing Subhan Zakhail to rise over the bounce and carve a ferocious cut past point while third man desperately gives chase in vain.
9.1: Mohit Ulva introduces himself with width, and Faridullah Ihsas immediately flashes a cut into the off-side to take a single.
9.2: Mohit Ulva hits the back of a length, and Subhan Zakhail swiftly drops his weight, pressing backward to dead-bat the delivery into the off-side.
9.3: Mohit tosses up width outside off, allowing Subhan Zakhail to carve a sharp cut toward the third-man region for a single.
9.4: Mohit Ulva spears one into the pads, clipping Faridullah Ihsas before deflecting away off the thigh pad down to fine leg.
9.5: Mohit Ulva targets the channel outside off, and Subhan Zakhail deadens the ball down toward point.
22.1: Manal Chauhan loops it full outside off, and Shah Faisal Rahimi dead-bats it back down the pitch.
22.2: Manal Chauhan drifts a full delivery onto leg stump, allowing Shah Faisal Rahimi to work it easily down to long-on for a single.
22.3: Noman Salarzai clears his front leg as the ball drifts across, steering it into the gap wide of extra cover to rotate the strike.
22.4: Manal Chauhan tosses it up around off, and Shah Faisal Rahimi meets it solidly right back down the surface.
22.5: Pitching on a good length outside off, Shah Faisal Rahimi strides forward and opens the face to glide the ball toward point.
22.6: Firing a flatter delivery outside off, Manal Chauhan watches as Shah Faisal Rahimi cuts it sharply straight to point.
23.1: Yashbardhan Chauhan slides one into off stump, cramping Noman Salarzai for room as he punches off the back foot to cover.
23.2: Floated up just outside off by Yashbardhan Chauhan, Noman Salarzai drives it crisply toward the cover fielder.
23.3: Yashbardhan Chauhan tosses it on a length outside off, and Noman Salarzai gets forward to dead-bat it toward point.
23.4: Offered width outside off, Noman Salarzai flashes at the cut but mistimes it straight to the point fielder.
23.5: Noman Salarzai hangs back in his crease, punching Yashbardhan Chauhan firmly down the pitch back to the bowler.
23.6: Yashbardhan Chauhan completes a maiden as Noman Salarzai plays off the back foot, nudging the final ball safely back to the bowler.
24.1: Manal Chauhan drops a length ball sliding into off, and Shah Faisal Rahimi steers it precariously close to his own stumps off the inside edge.
24.2: Shah Faisal Rahimi pushes it firmly, prompting a full-stretch diving stop to the left by bowler Manal Chauhan to deny the single.
24.3: Shah Faisal Rahimi rocks onto the back foot to punch Manal Chauhan away toward deep point for a single.
24.4: Noman Salarzai gets forward to a delivery sliding across off from Manal Chauhan and knocks it straight down the ground.
24.5: Shah Faisal Rahimi attempts an off-side drive against Manal Chauhan, only to drag it off the inside half straight to midwicket.
24.6: Shah Faisal Rahimi works off the back foot against a good length delivery from Manal Chauhan, steering it cleanly to sweeper cover for a single.
25.1: Yashbardhan Chauhan tosses one up on middle, clipped wide of the bowler who gets a desperate hand to it but cannot prevent the single.
25.2: Yashbardhan Chauhan delivers to Noman Salarzai, pushed through smartly to sweeper cover for a single.
25.3: Dot ball from Yashbardhan Chauhan to Shah Faisal Rahimi.
41.3: Manal Chauhan drops it in on a length to middle, where Shah Faisal Rahimi dead-bats it straight back down the strip.
41.4: Manal Chauhan lets one slip past his right hand as Shah Faisal Rahimi pushes it down the ground for a single toward long-on.
41.5: Manal Chauhan fires it in, and Sohail Khan stays rooted in his crease to pat it toward the cover fielder.
41.6: Manal Chauhan delivers, and Sohail Khan skips down the track to loft a drive down towards long-off.
42.1: Aryan Savsani floats one drifting into middle and leg, prompting Sohail Khan to hang back and prod it back to the bowler.
42.2: Aryan Savsani offers flight, and Sohail Khan dances down the wicket to launch a massive strike soaring over the long-on ropes.
42.3: Aryan Savsani overpitches wide of off, allowing Sohail Khan to whip the delivery away toward long-on.
42.4: Aryan Savsani slides one onto middle stump, and Shah Faisal Rahimi punches it solidly back down the pitch.
42.5: Aryan Savsani tosses it up outside off, and Shah Faisal Rahimi scrambles through for a tight single past extra cover despite a sharp fielding effort.
42.6: Aryan Savsani watches Sohail Khan steer a straightforward single away into the vacant expanse wide of extra cover.
43.1: Ishan Sood lands one on a good length outside off, leaving Sohail Khan reaching from the crease and comprehensively beaten by the movement.
43.2: Ishan Sood bangs it back of a length just outside off, and Sohail Khan steers it wide of backward point for a comfortable single.
43.3: Ishan Sood fires a yorker wide outside off, squeezed toward backward point by Shah Faisal Rahimi for a sharp single as the desperate throw flashes past.
43.4: Ishan Sood digs one back of a length in the channel, allowing Sohail Khan to guide it down to third man for a comfortable single.
43.5: Ishan Sood induces absolute chaos as Shah Faisal Rahimi cuts to point for a scrambling two amid a missed direct hit and a frantic ricochet.
43.6: Ishan Sood tests Shah Faisal Rahimi with a tight line, punched firmly from the crease straight to backward point to conclude a breathless over.
44.1: Mohit Ulva greets Sohail Khan with a delivery steered away cleanly to deep backward point for a smooth single.
48.4: Ishan Sood fires in a yorker at the toes, allowing Mohammad Ali to squeeze it through square leg and scramble back for two runs.
48.5: Ishan Sood misses his yorker and serves a full toss on the pads, which Mohammad Ali stylishly flicks over square leg for a maximum.
48.6: Ishan Sood rattles the base of leg stump to bowl Mohammad Ali for 8, delivering a fiery send-off after the batter charged down, swung hard at a full toss, and missed completely.
49.1: Kavya Patel zips a length delivery past the outside edge as Sohail Khan swings wildly into the on-side and finds only air.
49.2: Sohail Khan mistimes his drive down to long-off against Kavya Patel, picking up a single.
49.3: Kavya Patel darts a very full delivery just outside off, and Noor Ali Niazi squeezes it straight down the ground to return for a brisk couple.
49.4: Noor Ali Niazi unleashes brute bottom-hand power against Kavya Patel, launching a good-length ball over the long-on boundary with minimal followthrough.
49.5: Kavya Patel beats the bat with a good-length delivery outside off, and the batters scamper through for a bye as the ball races past everyone.
49.6: Sohail Khan squeezes a yorker outside off to long-off, and a sloppy fumble by bowler Kavya Patel on the errant throw gifts the batting side an extra run to complete three.
0.1: Noor Ali Niazi tests Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani with a short away-angler outside off, catching the batter horribly out of position on an attempted pull that drops safely short of the fielders.
0.2: Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani contemplates a cut against Noor Ali Niazi's back-of-a-length delivery, but wisely watches it shape away and leaves it alone.

0.3: Noor Ali Niazi angles a sharp delivery back into Lakshya Raichandani, catching the thigh pad as the batsman retreats on the back foot, while the bowler's vociferous appeal for leg-before is rightfully dismissed for height.

0.4: Noor Ali Niazi sprays this one miles wide outside off, forcing wicketkeeper Noman Salarzai into a sharp diving stop to his right in front of first slip as the batters scramble through for an extra run.
0.4: Noor Ali Niazi attacks a short of length outside off, forcing Aaryavir Sehwag to watch the ball shape away and safely pass through to the keeper.
0.5: Noor Ali Niazi delivers back of a length outside off, generating late movement and bounce that leaves Aaryavir Sehwag dangling his bat and beating the outside edge entirely.
12.3: Sohail Khan tosses it up to Aaryavir Sehwag, who dances down the track and launches it cleanly straight over the fence for a maximum.
12.4: Sohail Khan angles it in from round the wicket, meeting Aaryavir Sehwag's forward defensive push which the bowler instantly gathers.
12.5: Sohail Khan lands a full delivery on middle, and Aaryavir Sehwag steps forward to drive it comfortably down towards long-on.
12.6: Sohail Khan delivers a flat, good-length ball outside off, allowing Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani to retreat onto the back foot and punch it cleanly to long-off.
13.1: Mohammad Ali fires a flat good-length delivery outside off, and Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani punches it wide of mid-off where a sliding effort saves two runs.
13.2: Mohammad Ali tosses it full outside off, and Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani lofts it cleanly over mid-off for a boundary on the bounce.
13.3: Mohammad Ali pitches on a good length outside off, where Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani punches to mid-off and scampers through after a shy and a fumble to reach his fifty.
13.4: Mohammad Ali loops in a googly outside off, and Aaryavir Sehwag drops back on his stumps to punch it toward sweeper cover.
13.5: Mohammad Ali drops it short, and Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani cashes in with a fierce back-foot punch past the diving cover fielder for four.
13.6: Mohammad Ali tosses it full outside leg, and Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani strides forward to whip it straight to mid-wicket.
14.1: Sohail Khan serves up a full delivery on off stump, which Aaryavir Sehwag drives firmly right back into the bowler's hands.
14.2: Sohail Khan delivers a flat good-length ball on off, and Aaryavir Sehwag nudges it to mid-wicket where a fumble allows a single that brings up the team century.
14.3: Sohail Khan serves it on a good length outside off, allowing Lakshya Raichandani to drop back and punch a single down to long-off.
14.4: Sohail Khan floats it full and invites punishment, and Aaryavir Sehwag accepts the invitation by launching it majestically over long-on with pure muscle.
14.5: Sohail Khan angles it in from round the wicket on a good length outside off, and Aaryavir Sehwag retreats to punch it toward long-off for a single.
14.6: Sohail Khan pitches it full outside off, and Lakshya Raichandani leans forward to stroke it cleanly towards long-off.
15.1: Mohammad Ali drops one on a good length that turns into middle, prompting Lakshya Raichandani to work it softly toward mid-wicket.
15.2: Mohammad Ali tosses it full just outside leg, and Lakshya Raichandani presses forward to flick it away toward short fine.
15.3: Mohammad Ali delivers to Lakshya Raichandani, who rotates the strike with a single out to deep square leg.
15.4: Dot ball from Mohammad Ali to Aaryavir Sehwag.
27.6: Sohail Khan spears it flat and wide outside off as Lakshya Raichandani dances down the track, missing the pitch entirely to thrust a desperate defensive bat.
28.1: Amir Hamza hits a back-of-a-length line across off stump, comfortably steered by VK Vineeth toward backward point.
28.2: Amir Hamza drops it back of a length on off, and VK Vineeth stays on the crease to bunt it firmly into the off-side.
28.3: Amir Hamza drifts too straight onto the pads, allowing VK Vineeth to effortlessly whip the gift away through midwicket for a boundary.
28.4: Amir Hamza floats an overpitched delivery on off, and VK Vineeth mistimes his drive straight to mid-off.
28.5: Amir Hamza lands a good-length ball on off, met by VK Vineeth on a solid forward prod.
28.6: Amir Hamza angles a length delivery away outside off, catching VK Vineeth reaching on the up to mistime it left of backward point.
29.1: Sohail Khan delivers a flat length ball outside off, stabbed off the back foot before a diving stop halts it to the right of point.
29.2: Sohail Khan tests Lakshya Raichandani on the back foot, who drags an attempted off-side punch off the inside half straight back down the pitch.
29.3: Sohail Khan darts a short one into the stumps, neatly tucked off the back foot by Lakshya Raichandani wide of midwicket for a single.
29.4: Sohail Khan fires it flat on off, and VK Vineeth leans back to dead-bat the ball toward cover.
29.5: Sohail Khan targets the off stump on a length, gently tapped from the crease by VK Vineeth just to the left of the bowler.
29.6: Sohail Khan spears a length delivery onto the leg stump, and VK Vineeth presents the full blade to push it down to long-on for a single.
30.1: Amir Hamza fires a full delivery wide of off stump, drawing VK Vineeth forward into a drive straight toward mid-off.
30.2: Amir Hamza digs one in short near the ribcage, allowing VK Vineeth to ride the bounce deftly and tuck it fine toward the leg-side boundary.
30.3: Amir Hamza lands this one back of a length just outside off, met by a solid punch from Lakshya Raichandani directly to the mid-off fielder.
30.4: Amir Hamza pitches it right up on middle, catching Lakshya Raichandani leaning slightly ahead as he manages to squeeze it out toward mid-on.
30.5: Amir Hamza bangs it in short, prompting Lakshya Raichandani to hop onto the crease, absorb the bounce, and steer it wide of midwicket for a comfortable run.
30.6: No-ball from Amir Hamza to VK Vineeth.
34.4: Amir Hamza drifts it full outside off, allowing Yashbardhan Chauhan to step forward and push a single toward sweeper cover.
34.5: Amir Hamza attacks the pads with a full delivery, and VK Vineeth works it away behind square for a single.
34.6: Yashbardhan Chauhan goes back to a shortish delivery from Amir Hamza, muscling a pull over mid-on to find the gap for four.
35.1: Sohail Khan targets a flat good length, prompting VK Vineeth to create space on the back foot and punch to sweeper cover.
35.2: Sohail Khan tosses up a slower, fuller ball outside off that Yashbardhan Chauhan lofts cleanly over the infield for four.
35.3: Yashbardhan Chauhan brilliantly opens the face against a full delivery from Sohail Khan, steering it past short third man for consecutive boundaries.
35.4: Sohail Khan fires it full and quick on off, safely driven past the bowler by Yashbardhan Chauhan for a brisk single.
35.5: Sohail Khan delivers a slower good-length ball on off, which VK Vineeth punches firmly toward the cover fielder.
35.6: Sohail Khan fires a full delivery straight at the stumps, forcing VK Vineeth to drive it firmly back down the pitch.
36.1: Noor Ali Niazi angles a good-length ball outside off, where Yashbardhan Chauhan goes back to punch it toward backward point.
36.2: Noor Ali Niazi gets one to nip back into off, causing Yashbardhan Chauhan's bat to twist as he nudges a quick single to mid-on.
36.3: Noor Ali Niazi bowls a gorgeous delivery that pitches short and seams away sharply to beat VK Vineeth's defensive prod.
36.4: Noor Ali Niazi drifts short outside off, and VK Vineeth punches it crisply through the cover region to race past fifty in style.
36.5: Noor Ali Niazi drops it short on off, and VK Vineeth swats it disdainfully over long-on to seal India's march into the final.

summary.text: India U19 won by 8 wkts after restricting AFGU19 to 227-8, where Noman Salarzai (wk) was the top scorer with 51 off 78 balls and Ishan Sood took 3 for 43. INDU19 chased the target with 230-2, led by top scorer Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani (c) with 93 off 90 balls, while Sohail Khan (c) took 1 for 56.
